image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a turtle being held in a human hand. The image focuses entirely on the plastron (underside/belly) of the turtle. The plastron is large, smooth, and orange-brown with distinct scute patterns and dark margins. The turtle's head, limbs, and tail are mostly obscured or out of frame, though parts of the carapace edge and small portions of the limbs are visible at the periphery. The background shows blurred ground vegetation.
